Who We Are

MAAAX Udyog Samuh

MAAAX is a pioneering Marathi-owned wholesale garment enterprise — one of the very first successful Marathi ventures in the garment industry. From a factory floor in Hadapsar to multiple own brands, MAAAX is building a fashion empire from scratch.
